title: Windows Event logs (winevtlog)

fields.name: channels
fields.description: A comma-separated list of channels to read from.

fields.name: db
fields.description: Optional. Set the path to save the read offsets.

fields.name: event_query
fields.description: Specify XML query for filtering events.

fields.name: ignore_missing_channels
fields.description: Optional. Whether to ignore event channels not present in the event log, and continue running with subscribed channels.

fields.name: interval_nsec
fields.description: Optional. Set the polling interval for each channel. (nanoseconds)

fields.name: interval_sec
fields.description: Optional. Set the polling interval for each channel.

fields.name: read_existing_events
fields.description: Optional. Whether to read existing events from head or tailing events at last on subscribing.

fields.name: remote.domain
fields.description: Specify domain name of remote access for Windows EventLog.

fields.name: remote.password
fields.description: Specify password of remote access for Windows EventLog.

fields.name: remote.server
fields.description: Specify server name of remote access for Windows EventLog.

fields.name: remote.username
fields.description: Specify user name of remote access for Windows EventLog.

fields.name: render_event_as_text
fields.description: Optional. Render the Windows EventLog event as newline-separated key=value text. Mutually exclusive with render_event_as_xml.

fields.name: render_event_as_xml
fields.description: Optional. Render the Windows EventLog event as XML, including the System and Message fields. Mutually exclusive with render_event_as_text.

fields.name: render_event_text_key
fields.description: Optional. Record key name used to store the rendered text when render_event_as_text is enabled.

fields.name: string_inserts
fields.description: Optional. Whether to include string inserts in output records.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own thread.

fields.name: use_ansi
fields.description: Optional. Use ANSI encoding on eventlog messages. If you have issues receiving blank strings with old Windows versions (Server 2012 R2), setting this to true might solve the problem.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Fluent Bit input plugin: Windows Event logs (winevtlog).
